name: AWS ParallelCluster
overview: AWS ParallelCluster deploys and manages HPC clusters on AWS using configurable scheduler, compute fleet, storage and networking.
examSignals: Create configurable HPC cluster with schedulers such as Slurm: ParallelCluster
Run independent batch jobs with managed queue scheduling: AWS Batch

compareWith.diff: ParallelCluster provisions a traditional HPC cluster/scheduler; Batch abstracts job queues and managed compute scheduling.
